title: Large-media ingest, processing, dependency degradation, and recovery
accessibility: Progress, queue, retry, and failure states are announced without focus loss
Mobile and desktop operators can cancel or retry without pointer-only controls
Automated critical and serious accessibility violations equal zero
securityInvariants: Storage, job, and health detail never disclose credentials or another tenant
Worker and reconciliation endpoints require explicit machine authority
Provider failover cannot change project, version, checksum, or billing scope
persistence: Upload and job checkpoints survive restart
Catalog and object placement reconcile after partial dependency recovery
concurrency: Tenant and global limits enforce bounded parallelism
Duplicate chunks, workers, and reconciliation attempts are idempotent
degradedDependencies: Database, storage, transcode, notification, and network failures are fault-injected
Readiness withdraws traffic while liveness remains available
Backpressure rejects before memory, disk, or provider exhaustion
rollback: In-flight jobs survive or terminate safely across application rollback
Failed provider migration preserves source and catalog authority
